notes.title: Steam Deck Compatible!
notes.content:
I was able to grab a Steam Deck during this last Steam sale. I'm happy to say that my initial testing shows Guts 'n Grunts running flawlessly on the device!

Unfortunately, I'm not yet invited to the Deck Verified program. As soon as that is available to me, I will submit the game.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
There was a bug where your saved upgrades weren't loading after closing and reopening the game. This is now fixed. If you update to the latest version of the game, you should be able to load up your purchased upgrades even if you weren't seeing them before.

If you have any issues, please let me know.

notes.title: Release Date Soon
notes.content:
Guts 'n Grunts will receive an official release date soon. The delays are due to the time it has taken to get it ported to consoles. The good news is that the game has been improved during this port process and those improvements will be in the Steam version of the game. The bad news is it will either launch in October this year or be delayed to January 2024. Once there is a final release date, it will be posted here.

This is our biggest and best game yet and we're excited to share it with everyone as soon as we can.
